question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s centralized authority and absence of viable challengers underpin trader expectations that he will remain in power through 2026. Recent months have featured continued anti-corruption purges of senior Politburo and military figures, which analysts interpret as tools for enforcing loyalty rather than signs of instability. Xi, who turned 73 in June 2026, has shown no intention of stepping aside ahead of the 21st Party Congress scheduled for late 2027, where he is widely expected to secure another term. Trusted allies such as Cai Qi are overseeing personnel vetting and ideological discipline campaigns to shape the next leadership cohort while preserving Xi’s dominance. With no public signals of resignation, health concerns, or elite opposition emerging, the market’s implied probability reflects broad consensus on institutional continuity under his leadership.
